service.method: SELECT A.* FROM ( SELECT GWGL.HOUSE_CODE , GWGL.COMPANY_CODE , GWGL.APP_NO , GWGL.APP_NO_SEQ , GWGL.APP_SUBJECT , GWGL.SUX_WKEY1 AS SMR_NUMBER , GWGL.APP_USER_ID AS REQ_USER_ID FROM SGWGL GWGL WHERE GWGL.HOUSE_CODE = ${session.HOUSE_CODE} AND GWGL.COMPANY_CODE = ${session.COMPANY_CODE} AND #DB_OWNER#NVL(GWGL.DEL_FLAG,'N') = 'N' AND GWGL.APP_TYPE IN ('J01', 'J02') AND #DB_OWNER#NVL(GWGL.SUX_WKEY4, '') = '' ) A ORDER BY A.APP_NO, A.APP_NO_SEQ

SELECT SIAD.SUBJECT AS SUBJECT , SIAD.EXPLANATION AS EXPLANATION , poaseal_one.GETCODETEXT('004', 'SL003', SIAD.RE_FLAG, 'KO') AS RE_FLAG , UDGL.SUBJECT AS REQ_SEAL_USE_TYPE , SIAD.SUBMISSION_PLACE AS SUBMISSION_PLACE , SIAD.REMARK AS REMARK FROM SSIAD SIAD JOIN sudgl UDGL ON UDGL.HOUSE_CODE = SIAD.house_code AND UDGL.COMPANY_CODE = SIAD.company_code AND UDGL.USE_NUMBER = SIAD.REQ_SEAL_USE_TYPE WHERE SIAD.HOUSE_CODE = ${session.HOUSE_CODE} AND SIAD.COMPANY_CODE = ${session.COMPANY_CODE} AND SIAD.SMR_NUMBER = ${SMR_NUMBER} ORDER BY SIAD.SMR_NUMBER DESC

SELECT poaseal_one.GETCODETEXT('004', 'SM001', SIPD.SEAL_TYPE, 'KO') AS SEAL_TYPE , SEAL.SUBJECT AS SEAL_MG_SUBJECT , SIPD.SUBJECT AS SUBJECT , SIPD.DOWN_COUNT AS COUNT , SIPD.REAL_ATTACH_NO AS ATTACH_NO FROM SSIPD SIPD JOIN SSIPD_SEAL SIPD_SEAL ON SIPD_SEAL.HOUSE_CODE = SIPD.HOUSE_CODE AND SIPD_SEAL.COMPANY_CODE = SIPD.COMPANY_CODE AND SIPD_SEAL.SMR_NUMBER = SIPD.SMR_NUMBER AND SIPD_SEAL.SMD_NUMBER = SIPD.SMD_NUMBER JOIN SSEAL SEAL ON SEAL.HOUSE_CODE = SIPD.HOUSE_CODE AND SEAL.COMPANY_CODE = SIPD.COMPANY_CODE AND SEAL.MANAGE_NUMBER = SIPD_SEAL.MANAGE_NUMBER WHERE SIPD.HOUSE_CODE = ${session.HOUSE_CODE} AND SIPD.COMPANY_CODE = ${session.COMPANY_CODE} AND SIPD.SMR_NUMBER = ${SMR_NUMBER}

SELECT SRAD.SUBJECT AS SMI_NUMBER , CASE WHEN SISD.REAL_DOC_CHK = '1' THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS REAL_DOC_CHK , SISD.CONTENTS AS CONTENTS , SISD.COUNT AS COUNT FROM SSISD SISD JOIN SSRAD SRAD ON SRAD.HOUSE_CODE = SISD.HOUSE_CODE AND SRAD.COMPANY_CODE = SISD.COMPANY_CODE AND SRAD.SMI_NUMBER = SISD.SMI_NUMBER WHERE SISD.HOUSE_CODE = ${session.HOUSE_CODE} AND SISD.COMPANY_CODE = ${session.COMPANY_CODE} AND SISD.SMR_NUMBER = ${SMR_NUMBER}
SELECT FILE_NAME_CLIENT , FILE_NAME_SERVER , LAYER FROM SFMFI WHERE HOUSE_CODE = ${session.HOUSE_CODE} AND COMPANY_CODE = ${session.COMPANY_CODE} AND DOC_NUMBER LIKE CONCAT(${SMR_NUMBER}, '%')
